metadata.text:
Choose a non-eternal item.
It becomes a room. Expand
room slots by 1 and put
it in the new slot.
(Its no longer an item and isn't
controlled by any player. The
active player can activate its
abilities. Abilities that refer to
"you", or don't specify a target,
target the active player.)

HP: 6 | DC: 6 | AT: 6

When this is attacked, reveal the
top card of the monster deck.
This becomes a copy of that card,
then gains "If this would leave
play, the active player puts
it in their hand instead."
------------------------------
-Ambush-
------------------------------
Rewards: ?
